description: Appraisal Reduction Amount for a delinquent CMBS loan from a new appraisal, using the formula in a 2025 pooling and servicing agreement: balance minus (90% of appraised value + reserves - unpaid interest, advances and other amounts due). Returns the value side, the reduction, the share of scheduled interest the servicer keeps advancing, and the 25% deemed reduction that applies if no appraisal arrives in time.

advances.description: Unreimbursed P&I and servicing advances, with interest, in dollars. Default 0.

appraised_value.description: New appraised value in dollars, e.g. 28000000.

other_due.description: Unpaid taxes, insurance, ground rent, special servicing fees and other amounts due, in dollars. Default 0.

reserves.description: Escrows, reserves and letters of credit in dollars. Default 0.

unpaid_interest.description: Unpaid interest at the mortgage rate in dollars. Default 0.

name: calculate_appraisal_reduction
title: CMBS appraisal reduction amount
